blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is on track with its vaccination drive and efforts to assist local governments to curb the spread of COVID-19. To date, thousands of frontliners, medical health workers, Barangay Health Workers, Barangay Health Emergency Response teams, Barangay Nutrition Scholars, and Senior Citizens have been inoculated.

To also encourage their constituents to get vaccinated, Tuguegarao City Mayor Jefferson Soriano, Antipolo City Mayor Andeng Ynares, and Vice Mayor Mike Rama as Cebu City vaccine czar, appointed by Mayor Edgardo Labella received their first dose of COVID-19 vaccine at Robinsons Malls- Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Antipolo, and Robinsons Galleria Cebu.
Robinsons Malls even made the inoculation more convenient when it partnered with the LGU of Imus City and hosted a drive-thru vaccination drive at the mall’s levels 3 and 4 parking area.

And now, Robinsons Place GenSan is a new mega-vaccination hub to provide residents with an accessible, safe, and convenient way to get vaccinated. Future sites in Metro Manila, Visayas and Mindanao are in the pipeline.

Due to its strategic location in key cities, large and clean spaces, and accessibility, Robinsons Malls has become the preferred sites to launch each city’s vaccination drive. More Robinsons Malls branches will open up as vaccination sites as it remains dedicated to its commitment to fight the battle against COVID-19.
For more updates, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like Robinsons Malls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
